book.name: 1 Pedro
book.title: To Una no Suyat ni Pedro

content: Na, manno pigbag-u kow on to Diyus, ojowi now on to tibo madoot no mgo hinang, tibo paglimbung, pagpatitinood, pagsilag dow yain-yain no pagdoot-doot.
Maangod kow podom to bag-u i-anak no bata no gustu kanunoy ogdudu duon to inoy, no ko ita pa, kanunoy kow podom og-awos ogpaminog to kagi to Diyus no wada sakot agun no ogsangkod to pagtuu now.
Su naantihan now on to kadojow to Ginuu iyu.
Si Jesus dow mgo Sakup Din Impag-angod to Batu

Padani kow ki Jesu-Cristo. Buhi yagboy sikandin aw ogbogoy to kinabuhi no wada katapusan. Angod sikandin to batu no ighinang to bayoy no pig-ojowan to mgo pandoy su nailing to boot dan no wada pues, di sikandin nasi to pigpili to Diyus su iyan man mahal din yagboy.

Sikiyu isab pigbogajan on to kinabuhi no wada katapusan aw kangkahinang no kibali batu no ighinang to Diyus to bayoy din. Impag-angod kow isab to diya mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru su pinili kow din to paghalad to ispirituhanon no mgo halad no igpabaja ki Jesu-Cristo. Sikan to ogkaliyagan to Diyus.
Su meyduon kagi din duon to Kasuyatan no pig-iling din,

content.text: “Pigpili ku to mahalon yagboy no batu no indigon to sikan bayoy ku diya to siyudad to Sion.
Inggad hintawa no ogsalig kandin wada yagboy igkamahay.”

content: Si Jesu-Cristo sikan impananglit to batu.
Mahal hilabi sikandin iyu no namanuu. Di meyduon kagi to Diyus bahin to diya wada pamanuu no pig-iling,

content.text: “Sikan batu no pig-ojowan to mgo pandoy
su nailing to boot dan no wada pues

content: Pig-iling isab duon to Kasuyatan,

content.text: “Ogpakasipdug to mgo otow to sikan no batu aw ogpakadugsu.”

content: Ogpakadugsu sikandan su wada dan tuuhi to kagi to Diyus. Sikan to ing-andam din kandan.

Di sikiyu, kona kow no angod kandan su pigpili kow to Diyus aw angod kow to diya mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru su pigbogajan kow to katongdanan to pagtuman kandin no iyan Hari. Pigyain kow din agun no mahinang no kaotawan din, agun isab no ipatangkap now sikan nawnangonon bahin to kabeynganan no mgo hinang din, su sikandin to migpayuwas iyu duon to kadigyoman aw balhina kow duon to sikan kabeynganan yagboy no kaawang din.
To diya una, wada kow kasakup to Diyus, di kuntoon mgo sakup kow din on. To diya una, wada yabot now to kayuuy to Diyus, di kuntoon pig-abut kow on to kayuuy din.
To Angay no Ogbatasanon to Kaotawan to Diyus
Mgo hinigugma ku, angod ki to mgo yampot
kani to babow to kalibutan, su kona no matuud no banwa ta seini. Kaling oghangyuon ku sikiyu no likajan now to madoot no mgo kagustuhon no iyan ogpaggera iyu agun kona kow makasugut to Diyus.

Kinahangyan no matarong yagboy to pamatasan now diya to mgo otow no wada Diyus. Su inggad hapoyan kow dan to madoot, ogkakitaan dan da gihapun no madojow to mgo hinang now. Na, ogpakasaja sikandan to Diyus diya to umaabut no panahon ko umandini sikandin.
Manno mgo sakup kow on to Ginuu, kinahangyan no suguton now to tibo namangatongdanan to gubernu. Suguta to panguyu to nasyun now su sikandin to yabow to katongod.
Suguta isab to mgo gubernadur su sikandan to pigsaligan to panguyu to pagkastigu to mgo otow no oghinang to madoot dow to pagsaja to oghinang to madojow.
Su iyan man pagboot to Diyus no matarong to oghinangon now agun no ogkatampod to pagsawoy iyu to mgo otow no wada dalimagmagan to matuud.
Mgo linuwas kow on iyan, di ajaw sikan oghinanga no balibadan to paghinang to madoot. Nasi no ipakita duon to mgo hinang now no mgo suguonon kow to Diyus.
Tahuda to tibo mgo otow. Higugmaa to angod now no mgo magtutuu, kahaedoki to Diyus aw tahuda to panguyu to nasyun now.
To Pagsunud to Kinaiya ni Cristo duon to mgo Pag-antus
Sikiyu no mgo suguonon, suguta aw tahuda yagboy to amu now inggad madojow sikandan ubin ko mayupig.
Su ko tongod to paghona-hona now to Diyus, ogpailub kow to pagpalisodi iyu inggad wada nahinang now no madoot, ogkasajaan to Diyus iyu.
Kona ogkasaja to otow no og-antus to kastigu tongod to madoot no hinang din. Di to otow no ogpailub ko palisod-lisodon tongod to matarong no hinang din, ogkasaja sikandin to Diyus.
Pagboot to Diyus no ogkailing to kinabuhi now, su si Cristo nakabaja isab to mgo pag-antus tongod iyu. Sikandin to sunudon now agun no maantus now isab to mgo kalisod.
Wada yagboy sae dow gayu din.
No sujan-sujanon
sikandin, wada sikandin bayos. No paantuson, wada sikandin panghinaedok. Nasi no insalig din puli to tibo diya to Diyus no iyan matarong ko oghukum.
To tibo mgo sae ta nadaya ni Jesus duon to kamatajon din duon to krus agun kona kid ogpakasae di nasi no iyan da oghinangon ta to matarong. Tongod to mgo pali no pig-antus din, namandojow ki.
To diya una, angod kow to mgo karneru no migpayagak-yagak. Di kuntoon nakabatuk kow on ki Cristo no og-atiman dow ogbantoy iyu.

footnotes.text: To Sion, Jerusalem no bantugan no siyudad to mgo Hibru.
